# FleetMores.in — Promoting TruckBill Transport ERP
> FleetMores is promoting TruckBill, India's premier transport operations and billing ERP for fleet owners, transport contractors, and freight brokers.

## Company & Flagship Product Summary
- **Organization**: FleetMores Technologies Pvt Ltd
- **Product Name**: TruckBill
- **Product Type**: Cloud-based Transport Operations & Billing ERP
- **Primary Function**: Automates digital LR (Lorry Receipt / Bilty) generation, trip dispatch, market lorry settlements, driver advances, petrol pump diesel audit, customer GST billing, and Section 194C TDS compliance.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Pan-India (Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, JNPT, Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune, Indore, Ludhiana, Jaipur, Hyderabad).
- **Official Website**: https://fleetmores.in/
- **Support & Sales Line**: +91 8000 553 311
- **Email**: contact@fleetmores.in

## 12 Specialized Engines of TruckBill
1. Digital LR & Bilty Engine (Auto-sequenced, pre-printed stationery alignment, WhatsApp PDF sharing)
2. Trip Dispatch & Vehicle Allocation (Loading slips, verified driver DL, own & market trucks)
3. Market Vehicle & Broker Settlement (Dual-rate lorry vouchers, commission margin locks)
4. Customer Invoicing & TDS Management (Multi-LR consolidated billing, automated Section 194C TDS)
5. Diesel & FASTag Audit (Pump statement reconciliation, toll debits, mileage control)
6. Mobile POD Capture (Driver smartphone photo upload of stamped receiving copy)
7. Transport Accounting & Khata (Double-entry party ledgers, broker khata, driver passbook)
8. Vehicle-Wise Net Profit & Loss (Per-truck monthly P&L, maintenance, and tyre wear)
9. Driver Trip Passbook (Transparent route advances, trip bata, zero dispute payouts)
10. RTO Expiry Reminders (Proactive WhatsApp alerts for Fitness, National Permit, Insurance)
11. Multi-Branch Hierarchy (Head office visibility over booking branches and delivery depots)
12. WhatsApp Business Intelligence (Automated document delivery and payment reminders)

## Pricing Plans (INR)
- **Starter**: ₹1,499 / month (Up to 15 trucks / single branch)
- **Growth (Recommended)**: ₹3,499 / month (15–70 trucks, multi-branch, diesel audit, full transport ledgers)
- **Enterprise**: Custom ROI plan (70+ trucks, custom API sync, dedicated support)

## Indian Compliance & Localization
- **GST Compliance**: Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM) & Forward Charge Mechanism (FCM) support.
- **Income Tax**: Automated Section 194C TDS deduction & Pan-10 truck declaration recordkeeping.
- **E-Way Bill**: E-Way bill number tracking and portal compatibility.
- **FASTag & Fuel**: Direct toll and pump slip reconciliation.
